sources.title: GitHub - a96123155/UTR-LM
sources.snippet: UTR-LM: A Semi-supervised 5' UTR Language Model for mRNA Translation and Expression Prediction The untranslated region (UTR) of an RNA molecule plays a vital role in gene expression regulation. Specifically, the 5' UTR, located at the 5' end of an RNA molecule, is a critical determinant of the RNA's translation efficiency.
